'''Clan Farlook''' was one of the districts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phemiss]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. It contained [[Hiakk Hall]], and was the home of [[Clan Farlook]]. It bordered the [[Clan Flashblade (district)|Clan Flashblade]], [[Clan Tallmeadow (district)|Clan Tallmeadow]], the [[Clan Sunsinger (district)|Clan Sunsinger]] districts.<ref name="CatCW" />
